title: self_recall_probe conflates unreachability with exact-duplicate dilution
wanted_capability: A recall diagnostic that stays meaningful on duplicate-heavy partitions. self_recall_probe requires a vector's own id in top-k; with N identical vectors sharing a query, own-id probability is ~k/N regardless of graph health, so the probe reads 0.78 on a fully connected duplicate-heavy partition (voyage_visual, 334 distinct payloads over 16925 entities). Options: probe for any same-content member (needs a content-hash side index), report a reachability-based metric instead, or document the dilution bound in the probe output so operators stop reading it as graph damage.
evidence: voyage_visual partition 2026-08-12: probe 0.7788 both at 6.7% zero-in-degree AND at 0 orphans after the reconnect pass
